title: Inverse image of a represented open free abelian sheaf
statement: Let $p:Y\to X$ be any morphism of schemes and $W$ an open subset of $X$ [def-sc-zariski-site]. Let $L_W$ and $L_{p^{-1}W}$ denote the represented open free abelian sheaves [lem-pc-free-mayer-vietoris-short-exact] on $X$ and $Y$, respectively. For the inverse-image functor [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison] there is an isomorphism $p^{-1}L_W\cong L_{p^{-1}W}$. No flatness, open-immersion or coefficient hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Compose Mathlib sheafificationAdjunction, AddCommGrpCat.adj.whiskerRight and yonedaEquiv to obtain Hom(L_W,F) equivalent to F(W), and verify naturality in F by homEquiv_naturality_right.

The sheafAdjunctionContinuous defining inverse image identifies Hom(p⁻¹L_W,F) with Hom(L_W,p_*F). Applying the sections equivalence identifies this with (p_*F)(W)=F(p⁻¹W), and its inverse on Y identifies it with Hom(L_{p⁻¹W},F). Verify naturality by the two preceding naturality identities. Apply Mathlib Coyoneda.ext to this natural equivalence and invert the resulting isomorphism to obtain the displayed orientation.
